correctness.rationale: Fix k, n→∞, and k independent uniform directed successor orders in pure equality+successor FO² of rank≤2. For each unordered order pair there are two orientations of shared directed edges, m=k(k−1) categories. The factorial-moment proof counts constraints on disjoint geometric edges as 1+O(1/n) and overlapping connected constraint families as O(1/n); compatible order-edge constraints require disjoint directed paths. Thus joint counts→independent Poisson(1). Endpoint collisions/triple shared edges/incident shared edges disappear with O_k(1/n), leaving local 2-types determined by the m presence bits. Rank-two closed sentences see exactly these bits and every Boolean function of them is expressible with ∃x∃y. Each Hamming layer contributes integer coefficient a_j between 0 and binom(m,j); polynomial independence in the Bernstein basis at transcendental e^−1 gives exactly ∏_{j=0}^m(binomial(m,j)+1) distinct limits (k=1:2, k=2:12, k=3:1,053,696). Direct independent enumeration for n=3..5 verified shared-edge means (n−1)/n; finite checks are not weak convergence.
